Information we collect

We collect only the minimum data needed to operate this site. Technical data can include IP address, browser type, pages viewed and cookie-related settings. Information you choose to provide through a future contact channel may also be processed.

How information is used

Information may help improve the guide, understand aggregated use, respond to requests and meet applicable legal obligations.

Third-party services

Google Maps is used for the embedded map. Google Analytics loads only if you grant analytics consent. Each third party applies its own privacy terms.

Your choices

You may change analytics consent at any time using Cookie Settings. For access, correction or erasure requests, use the contact route made available by the project.
